intake.description: The claimant was admitted as an emergency to City Care Hospital on 13 October 2026 with severe stomach pain and underwent surgery for appendicitis. Total estimated medical expenses are Rs 1,40,000.
intake.severity_reason: Severity is high because the claim involves an emergency hospital admission.

route.reason: policy number HLT-26-10552 has prefix for health; intake agent read the email as health

coverage.reasoning: The policy condition HLTH-CON-5.2 requires that claims must be supported by the original discharge summary and itemised hospital bill. The claim facts indicate that only a discharge summary and ID proof were attached, but the itemised hospital bill is not mentioned as provided. Therefore, the claim needs review to verify if the required original itemised bill has been submitted.

flags.fix: Request all missing documents in one consolidated message as soon as the coverage check is completed, ensuring the itemised bill is requested since it was not attached to the notice.
